checks: Text contrast at or above 4.5:1 for reviewed small-text color pairs

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Kimi overstated crates as the only source of every collectible.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex changed public copy to the approved claim that opening plush crates grows the collection.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Kimi introduced unsupported visibility, undo, cost, and value-list claims around trading.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex removed the claims and kept only approved controls plus explicitly labelled practical cautions.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Small mint and yellow label colors did not meet normal-text contrast.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex darkened both foreground tokens; calculated contrast is 6.98:1 and 5.08:1 respectively.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The mobile menu depended entirely on JavaScript.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex made the navigation visible by default and collapsible only when JavaScript is active.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Kimi used the stable core title while the research package records a temporary update tag.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex normalized the design-package identity field while retaining the stable core title in public navigation.

remaining_gate: Render and inspect 375px, 768px, and 1440px viewports after browser exclusivity is granted, then change status only if all visual checks pass.
